scientific_integrity: Claim concerns an integral homotopy equivalence proved by sequential element matching. Earlier numeric instances and the conjectured homology ranks are attributed to the motivating literature, not represented as independent discoveries. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The uniform proof concerns K_m Cartesian P_3, m>=2; not general P_n, n>=4. The symbolic acyclic matching is mathematical evidence; finite executable cases m=2..5 are cross-checks, not an infinite proof. Possible unindexed equivalent literature is unresolved.
title: Three-column total three-cut complexes of complete-clique paths
